L3Harris is a large, diversified national-security supplier -- it reports about $21.9 billion in annual revenue, operates in more than 100 countries, and is organized into segments spanning missile warning and defense, electronic warfare, space sensors and telescope components, aircraft modernization, counter-drone systems, and propulsion. The greater Phoenix-Mesa corridor has long been home to a cluster of defense electronics and communications manufacturing tied to L3Harris and its corporate predecessors, reflecting decades of consolidation among aerospace and defense electronics firms in the area.

Readers looking for verifiable technical specifications on this facility will not find them in the public record, and that gap should be read as consistent with the building's likely role as private infrastructure rather than as a gap in research.
